# runzero_users (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero users.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (Number) Total number of actions performed.
- `client_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a client administrator.
- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user was created.
- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the user.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the user.
- `invite_token_expiration` (Number) Unix timestamp when the invite token expires.
- `last_action_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last action.
- `last_activity_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last activity.
- `last_login_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last login.
- `last_login_ip` (String) IP address of the last login.
- `last_login_ua` (String) User agent string of the last login.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the user.
- `login_failures` (Number) Number of consecutive login failures.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled.
- `name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `org_default_role` (String) The default organization role for the user.
- `org_roles` (Map of String) Map of organization UUIDs to role names.
- `password_enabled_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when password authentication was enabled.
- `reset_token_expiration` (Number) Unix timestamp when the password reset token expires.
- `sso_only` (Boolean) Whether the user can only authenticate via SSO.
- `terms_agreed_as_of` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user agreed to the terms.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user was last updated.
